install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; VENV_BIN="$(pwd)/backend/.venv/bin"; grep -qxF "export PATH=\"$VENV_BIN:\$PATH\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export PATH=\"$VENV_BIN:\$PATH\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.agents/skills"; ln -sfn "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/lazarus-assistant" "$HOME/.agents/skills/lazarus-assistant"; uv sync --project backend; pnpm --dir frontend install
